section.p: This module handles the entire new student admissions process—from online or office registration, document verification, acceptance decisions, up to creating the official Student ID (NIM) and Portal login account.

div.p: PMB Committee members only see and process applicants applying to the Faculty or Study Program within their assigned work area.
Use the left-hand Search Panel in the Admissions list to filter applicants with one click by Faculty, Study Program, or Status.
The system prevents accepting an applicant if required documents are still missing, and protects already-registered students from accidental rejection.

div.class: mb-4 ps-4 border-start border-4 border-secondary position-relative
div.p: Who performs this: Prospective Student (Online) or PMB Committee (Office)
The applicant fills in personal data, email, phone, and desired Study Program. The system automatically assigns a unique Registration Number (e.g. PMB/2026/00001) and sets the status to Draft.

ul.li: Full name, valid email, chosen Faculty, and Study Program must be filled in before the application can be submitted.
Click Submit when the initial data is ready (Draft → Submitted), then click Start Document Review (Submitted → Document Review) to begin verification.

div.class: mb-4 ps-4 border-start border-4 border-warning position-relative
div.p: Every application arrives with a Document Checklist (e.g., Diploma, ID Card, Photo) based on the applicant's admission path. Click Start Document Review, then check and mark each submitted document and registration fee payment as verified.

ul.li: 100% Mandatory Documents Required: You cannot click Accept if any mandatory document in the checklist is still marked missing or unverified. Complete and verify all required items first.

div.class: mb-4 ps-4 border-start border-4 border-primary position-relative
div.p: Who performs this: PMB Committee / Administrator
Once all required documents are verified and the applicant passes selection, click Accept. The status changes to Accepted.

div.class: mb-4 ps-4 border-start border-4 border-success position-relative
div.h5: Stage 4: Final Enrollment (Create NIM & Student Account)
div.p: Who performs this: PMB Committee / Administrator
Click Register Student on an Accepted application. The system automatically completes four tasks at once:

ul.li: Generates Official NIM: Creates the Student Registration Number (NIM) based on Faculty, Study Program, and Enrollment Year.
Creates Student Profile: Adds the applicant to the official Student directory linked to their Faculty and Study Program.
Creates Portal Account: Sets up a Student Portal login account using the applicant's email address as their username.
Grants Portal Access: Enables the student to log in immediately to view schedules and fill out KRS.
An applicant can only be registered once. Returning students keep their permanent NIM and portal account, while emails already linked to non-student staff/lecturer accounts are refused.

div.class: mb-4 ps-4 border-start border-4 border-danger position-relative
div.p: Who performs this: PMB Committee / Administrator
If an applicant does not meet requirements (for example, invalid documents or failed selection), click Reject from the form or the Actions menu.

ul.li: Protected Final Status: Applications that are already Registered (with an issued NIM and Student Account) cannot be rejected, preventing accidental cancellation of enrolled students. Accepted no-shows who have not registered can still be rejected.

section.p: Prospective students can apply directly from the public admission frontend without logging in first:
section.div: Step 1 — Fetch Options & Submit Application: The public admission frontend loads active faculties, study programs, and fee rules from GET /api/admission/options and submits the applicant's details to POST /api/admission/submit, creating a new Draft application automatically.
Step 2 — Choosing Faculty & Program: Study programs are validated against the chosen Faculty on the server so applicants cannot submit a mismatched combination.

Step 3 — Payment Gates & Active Academic Year: The system automatically links the application to the currently active Academic Year; the PMB Committee verifies required documents and registration fee payment before Accept, and re-registration fee payment before Register Student.
